```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---- SETTINGS ----
infile <- "asv_all_with_complete_taxonomy.csv"
sheet  <- 1

rank_level <- "Order"   # "Class" also works
top_n_taxa <- 10

# y-scale choice:
use_log1p <- TRUE   # TRUE = log1p(total_reads) like a "log(cells/L)" style look
# if you already have log-transformed values, set FALSE

# ---- READ ----
raw <- read_csv(infile, sheet = sheet)

first_col <- names(raw)[1]
tax_labels <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species","Taxonomy_source")
taxa_cols <- names(raw)[grepl("^OTU_", names(raw))]
if (length(taxa_cols) == 0) stop("No OTU_* columns found (update taxa_cols selection).")

# split taxonomy rows vs data rows
tax_block  <- raw %>% filter(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels)
data_block <- raw %>% filter(!(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels))

# taxonomy lookup per OTU column
tax_lookup <- tax_block %>%
  select(all_of(first_col), all_of(taxa_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  rename(rank = all_of(first_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = value)

# long abundance table
long <- data_block %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance))) %>%
  left_join(tax_lookup, by = "taxon_col")

# ---- DATE PARSING (handles 10_12_2021 etc.) ----
if (!("Date" %in% names(long))) stop("No 'Date' column found.")
long <- long %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(str_replace_all(as.character(Date), "[_./]", "-")),
    MonthYear = floor_date(Date, "month")
  )

# ---- AGGREGATE AT TAXONOMIC RANK ----
if (!(rank_level %in% names(long))) stop(paste0("rank_level '", rank_level, "' not found."))

agg <- long %>%
  mutate(rank_value = as.character(.data[[rank_level]]),
         rank_value = ifelse(is.na(rank_value) | rank_value == "", "Unresolved", rank_value)) %>%
  group_by(MonthYear, rank_value) %>%
  summarise(total_reads = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- TOP 10 TAXA OVERALL ----
top_ranks <- agg %>%
  group_by(rank_value) %>%
  summarise(grand_total = sum(total_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(grand_total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n_taxa) %>%
  pull(rank_value)

plot_df <- agg %>%
  mutate(rank_value = ifelse(rank_value %in% top_ranks, rank_value, "Other")) %>%
  group_by(MonthYear, rank_value) %>%
  summarise(total_reads = sum(total_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# order legend: biggest on top, then Other last
legend_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(rank_value) %>%
  summarise(grand_total = sum(total_reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(grand_total)) %>%
  pull(rank_value)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(rank_value = factor(rank_value, levels = legend_order))

# y transform (to mimic log scale look)
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(y = if (use_log1p) log1p(total_reads) else total_reads)

# ---- PLOT (stacked bars, like your example) ----
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = MonthYear, y = y, fill = rank_value)) +
  geom_col(width = 25) +  # wide bars similar to monthly panels
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %y") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Temporal composition of dominant taxa (Top ", top_n_taxa, " ", rank_level, ")"),
    x = "Month-Year",
    y = if (use_log1p) "Abundance (log1p reads)" else "Abundance (reads)",
    fill = "Taxa"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p)

ggsave(paste0("dominant_taxa_top", top_n_taxa, "_", tolower(rank_level), "_stacked.png"),
       p, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Relative abundance (% of total ASV reads) for multiple ranks
# Time window: Sep 2021 to Jul 2022 (inclusive)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(forcats)
})

# ---- SETTINGS ----
infile <- "asv_all_with_taxonomy.xlsx"
sheet  <- 1

ranks_to_plot <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus")
top_n_taxa    <- 10
date_breaks   <- "1 month"
date_labels   <- "%b %y"
out_dir       <- "taxa_relabund_plots_sep21_jul22"

# inclusive window
start_month <- as.Date("2021-09-01")
end_month   <- as.Date("2022-07-01")

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- READ ----
raw <- read_excel(infile, sheet = sheet)

first_col  <- names(raw)[1]
tax_labels <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species","Taxonomy_source")
taxa_cols  <- names(raw)[grepl("^OTU_", names(raw))]
if (length(taxa_cols) == 0) stop("No OTU_* columns found (update taxa_cols selection).")

tax_block  <- raw %>% filter(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels)
data_block <- raw %>% filter(!(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels))

tax_lookup <- tax_block %>%
  select(all_of(first_col), all_of(taxa_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  rename(rank = all_of(first_col)) %>%
  mutate(rank = as.character(rank)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = value)

long <- data_block %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(abundance))) %>%
  left_join(tax_lookup, by = "taxon_col")

# ---- DATE PARSING ----
if (!("Date" %in% names(long))) stop("No 'Date' column found.")
long <- long %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(str_replace_all(as.character(Date), "[_./]", "-")),
    MonthYear = floor_date(Date, "month")
  )

if (all(is.na(long$MonthYear))) stop("Date parsing failed: MonthYear is all NA.")

# ---- FILTER WINDOW: Sep 2021 to Jul 2022 inclusive ----
long <- long %>%
  filter(MonthYear >= start_month, MonthYear <= end_month)

# ---- total ASV reads per month (denominator) ----
month_totals <- long %>%
  group_by(MonthYear) %>%
  summarise(total_asv_reads = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- helper: plot one rank as relative abundance ----
plot_rank_rel <- function(df_long, rank_level, top_n = 10, month_totals_df) {

  if (!(rank_level %in% names(df_long))) {
    stop(paste0("Rank column not found: ", rank_level))
  }

  agg <- df_long %>%
    mutate(rank_value = as.character(.data[[rank_level]]),
           rank_value = ifelse(is.na(rank_value) | rank_value == "", "Unresolved", rank_value)) %>%
    group_by(MonthYear, rank_value) %>%
    summarise(rank_reads = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Top N taxa overall in the window
  top_vals <- agg %>%
    group_by(rank_value) %>%
    summarise(grand_total = sum(rank_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(grand_total)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(rank_value)

  comp <- agg %>%
    mutate(rank_value = ifelse(rank_value %in% top_vals, rank_value, "Other")) %>%
    group_by(MonthYear, rank_value) %>%
    summarise(rank_reads = sum(rank_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(month_totals_df, by = "MonthYear") %>%
    mutate(rel_abund_pct = 100 * rank_reads / total_asv_reads)

  # Legend order by overall contribution (Other last)
  legend_levels <- comp %>%
    group_by(rank_value) %>%
    summarise(grand_total = sum(rank_reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(grand_total)) %>%
    pull(rank_value)

  if ("Other" %in% legend_levels) legend_levels <- c(setdiff(legend_levels, "Other"), "Other")

  comp <- comp %>%
    mutate(rank_value = factor(rank_value, levels = legend_levels))

  p <- ggplot(comp, aes(x = MonthYear, y = rel_abund_pct, fill = rank_value)) +
    geom_col(width = 25) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = date_breaks, date_labels = date_labels,
                 expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Relative abundance of ASV reads (", rank_level, ") — Sep 2021 to Jul 2022"),
      x = "Month-Year",
      y = "Relative abundance (% of total ASV reads)",
      fill = rank_level
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  p
}

# ---- run all ranks + save ----
plots <- list()

for (rk in ranks_to_plot) {
  p <- plot_rank_rel(long, rk, top_n = top_n_taxa, month_totals_df = month_totals)
  plots[[rk]] <- p

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("relabund_top", top_n_taxa, "_", tolower(rk), "_sep21_jul22.png"))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 11, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}

# print an example
print(plots[["Order"]])

message("Saved plots to: ", normalizePath(out_dir))

```

```{r}

  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)

# ===============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ===============================================================================
CONFIG <- list(
  infile = "asv_all_with_taxonomy.xlsx",
  sheet = 1,

  ranks = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"),
  top_n = 10,

  date_start = as.Date("2021-09-01"),
  date_end   = as.Date("2022-07-01"),

  plot_width  = 11,
  plot_height = 6,
  plot_dpi    = 300,

  output_dir = "taxa_relabund_plots_sep21_jul22"
)

dir.create(CONFIG$output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ===============================================================================
# DATA LOADING AND PROCESSING
# ===============================================================================
message("Reading data from: ", CONFIG$infile)
raw <- read_excel(CONFIG$infile, sheet = CONFIG$sheet)

first_col <- names(raw)[1]
tax_labels <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus",
                "Species", "Taxonomy_source")
taxa_cols <- names(raw)[grepl("^OTU_", names(raw))]

if (length(taxa_cols) == 0) stop("No OTU_* columns found. Check column naming.")
message("Found ", length(taxa_cols), " OTU columns")

tax_block  <- raw %>% filter(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels)
data_block <- raw %>% filter(!(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels))

tax_lookup <- tax_block %>%
  select(all_of(c(first_col, taxa_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  rename(rank = all_of(first_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = value)

long_data <- data_block %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = as.numeric(abundance)) %>%
  left_join(tax_lookup, by = "taxon_col")

# ===============================================================================
# DATE PARSING AND FILTERING
# ===============================================================================
if (!("Date" %in% names(long_data))) stop("'Date' column not found in data.")

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(str_replace_all(as.character(Date), "[_./]", "-")),
    MonthYear = floor_date(Date, "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    MonthYear >= CONFIG$date_start,
    MonthYear <= CONFIG$date_end,
    !is.na(abundance),
    abundance > 0
  )

if (nrow(long_data) == 0) stop("No data remaining after date filtering.")
message("Data range: ", min(long_data$MonthYear), " to ", max(long_data$MonthYear))

# Create discrete month label for plotting (removes “timeline gaps”)
month_levels <- seq(CONFIG$date_start, CONFIG$date_end, by = "month")
month_levels <- floor_date(month_levels, "month")
month_labels <- format(month_levels, "%b %y")

# ===============================================================================
# PLOTTING FUNCTION - RELATIVE ABUNDANCE THAT SUMS TO 100 PER MONTH
# ===============================================================================
create_relabund_plot <- function(data, rank_name, top_n) {

  if (!(rank_name %in% names(data))) stop("Rank '", rank_name, "' not found in data.")

  # Aggregate reads per Month x Taxon
rank_summary <- data %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = as.character(.data[[rank_name]]),
    taxon = str_trim(taxon),
    taxon = na_if(taxon, ""),                      # blanks -> NA
    taxon = if_else(is.na(taxon), NA_character_, taxon)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(taxon),
    !str_to_lower(taxon) %in% c("total", "unclassified")
  ) %>%
  group_by(MonthYear, taxon) %>%
  summarise(reads = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


  # Top N taxa overall
  top_taxa <- rank_summary %>%
    group_by(taxon) %>%
    summarise(total_reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total_reads)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(taxon)

  # Group to top taxa + Other, THEN compute RA so each month totals 100
  plot_data <- rank_summary %>%
    mutate(taxon_grouped = if_else(taxon %in% top_taxa, taxon, "Other")) %>%
    group_by(MonthYear, taxon_grouped) %>%
    summarise(reads = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(MonthYear) %>%
    mutate(rel_abundance = 100 * reads / sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # <-- key fix
    ungroup()

  # Consistent legend order; "Other" last
  taxon_order <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(taxon_grouped) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(reads), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    filter(taxon_grouped != "Other") %>%
    pull(taxon_grouped)
  taxon_order <- c(taxon_order, "Other")

  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      taxon_grouped = factor(taxon_grouped, levels = taxon_order),
      MonthLabel = factor(format(MonthYear, "%b %y"), levels = month_labels)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = MonthLabel, y = rel_abundance, fill = taxon_grouped)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.95) +  # discrete bars, no gaps due to date spacing
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 100),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Relative Abundance by %s (Sep 2021 - Jul 2022)", rank_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("Top %d taxa shown; remaining grouped as 'Other'", top_n),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Relative Abundance (% of total ASV reads)",
      fill = rank_name
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray30"),

      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.key        = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}

# ===============================================================================
# GENERATE AND SAVE ALL PLOTS
# ===============================================================================
message("\nGenerating plots...")

for (rank in CONFIG$ranks) {
  message("  Processing: ", rank)

  p <- create_relabund_plot(
    data = long_data,
    rank_name = rank,
    top_n = CONFIG$top_n
  )

  filename <- file.path(
    CONFIG$output_dir,
    sprintf("relabund_top%d_%s.png", CONFIG$top_n, tolower(rank))
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = p,
    width = CONFIG$plot_width,
    height = CONFIG$plot_height,
    dpi = CONFIG$plot_dpi
  )

  message("    Saved: ", basename(filename))
}

message("\n✓ Complete! Plots saved to: ", normalizePath(CONFIG$output_dir))

# ===============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS (optional sanity check)
# ===============================================================================
summary_stats <- long_data %>%
  group_by(MonthYear) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n_distinct(Date),
    n_otus = n_distinct(taxon_col),
    total_reads = sum(abundance),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

message("\nMonthly summary:")
print(summary_stats, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# ===============================================================================
# CONFIG
# ===============================================================================
CONFIG <- list(
  infile = "asv_all_with_taxonomy.xlsx",
  sheet = 1,
  date_start = as.Date("2021-09-01"),
  date_end   = as.Date("2022-07-01"),
  output_dir = "zooplankton_taxa_plots",
  keep_other = TRUE,            # FALSE to drop "Other"
  total_log10 = FALSE           # TRUE to plot log10(total_reads + 1)
)

# Taxa groups to match your figure (exact labels used in legend)
TAXA_GROUPS <- c(
  "Bivalvia",
  "Bryozoa",
  "Gastropoda",
  "Balanoida",
  "Brachiopoda",
  "Copepoda",
  "Hydrozoa",
  "Malacostraca",
  "Polychaeta"
)

dir.create(CONFIG$output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ===============================================================================
# HELPERS: map taxonomy -> the figure's taxa groups
# ===============================================================================
map_to_taxa_group <- function(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) {

  blob <- paste(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, sep = " ; ")
  blob <- str_to_lower(coalesce(blob, ""))

  case_when(
    str_detect(blob, "bivalv") ~ "Bivalvia",
    str_detect(blob, "gastropod") ~ "Gastropoda",
    str_detect(blob, "copepod") ~ "Copepoda",
    str_detect(blob, "malacostrac") ~ "Malacostraca",
    str_detect(blob, "polychaet") ~ "Polychaeta",
    str_detect(blob, "hydrozo") ~ "Hydrozoa",
    str_detect(blob, "bryozo") ~ "Bryozoa Larvae",
    str_detect(blob, "balanoid") ~ "Balanoida",
    str_detect(blob, "brachiopod") ~ "Brachiopoda",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}


# ===============================================================================
# LOAD + reshape
# ===============================================================================
raw <- read_excel(CONFIG$infile, sheet = CONFIG$sheet)

first_col <- names(raw)[1]
tax_labels <- c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species","Taxonomy_source")
taxa_cols <- names(raw)[grepl("^OTU_", names(raw))]
if (length(taxa_cols) == 0) stop("No OTU_* columns found.")

tax_block  <- raw %>% filter(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels)
data_block <- raw %>% filter(!(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels))

tax_lookup <- tax_block %>%
  select(all_of(c(first_col, taxa_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  rename(rank = all_of(first_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = value)

long_data <- data_block %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = as.numeric(abundance)) %>%
  left_join(tax_lookup, by = "taxon_col")

if (!("Date" %in% names(long_data))) stop("'Date' column not found in data.")

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(str_replace_all(as.character(Date), "[_./]", "-")),
    MonthYear = floor_date(Date, "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    MonthYear >= CONFIG$date_start,
    MonthYear <= CONFIG$date_end,
    !is.na(abundance),
    abundance > 0
  )


# Drop any OTUs whose taxonomy contains "total" in any rank field
tax_fields <- intersect(c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"), names(long_data))

long_data <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    !if_any(all_of(tax_fields), ~ str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(as.character(.x), "")), "total"))
  )


# Discrete months for “no gaps”
month_levels <- seq(CONFIG$date_start, CONFIG$date_end, by = "month") |> floor_date("month")
month_labels <- format(month_levels, "%B %y")  # "September 21" style like your figure

# ===============================================================================
# BUILD taxa-group table (match the figure)
# ===============================================================================
legend_levels <- if (CONFIG$keep_other) c(TAXA_GROUPS, "Other") else TAXA_GROUPS

grouped <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    taxa_group = map_to_taxa_group(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species)
  ) %>%
  group_by(MonthYear, taxa_group) %>%
  summarise(reads = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    MonthLabel = factor(format(MonthYear, "%B %y"), levels = month_labels),
    taxa_group = factor(taxa_group, levels = legend_levels)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(MonthLabel, taxa_group, fill = list(reads = 0))  # ensure missing groups show


# Force legend order = your figure order (+ Other last if kept)
legend_levels <- if (CONFIG$keep_other) c(TAXA_GROUPS, "Other") else TAXA_GROUPS

grouped <- grouped %>%
  mutate(
    MonthLabel = factor(format(MonthYear, "%B %y"), levels = month_labels),
    taxa_group = factor(taxa_group, levels = legend_levels)
  )

# ===============================================================================
# A) RELATIVE ABUNDANCE PLOT
# ===============================================================================
rel_df <- grouped %>%
  group_by(MonthYear) %>%
  mutate(rel_abundance = 100 * reads / sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(taxa_group != "Other") 

p_rel <- ggplot(rel_df, aes(x = MonthLabel, y = rel_abundance, fill = taxa_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.92) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal composition of dominant zooplankton taxa",
    subtitle = "Relative abundance (% of total ASV reads)",
    x = "Month-Year",
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "Taxa"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.key        = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

p_rel
```

```{r}
data <- read.csv("asv_all_with_complete_taxonomy.csv")

CONFIG <- list(
  infile = "asv_all_with_taxonomy.xlsx",
  sheet = 1,

  ranks = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus"),
  top_n = 10,

  date_start = as.Date("2021-09-01"),
  date_end   = as.Date("2022-07-01"),

  plot_width  = 11,
  plot_height = 6,
  plot_dpi    = 300,

  output_dir = "taxa_relabund_plots_sep21_jul22"
)

dir.create(CONFIG$output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ===============================================================================
# DATA LOADING AND PROCESSING
# ===============================================================================
message("Reading data from: ", CONFIG$infile)
raw <- read_excel(CONFIG$infile, sheet = CONFIG$sheet)

first_col <- names(raw)[1]
tax_labels <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus",
                "Species", "Taxonomy_source")
taxa_cols <- names(raw)[grepl("^OTU_", names(raw))]

if (length(taxa_cols) == 0) stop("No OTU_* columns found. Check column naming.")
message("Found ", length(taxa_cols), " OTU columns")

tax_block  <- raw %>% filter(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels)
data_block <- raw %>% filter(!(.data[[first_col]] %in% tax_labels))

tax_lookup <- tax_block %>%
  select(all_of(c(first_col, taxa_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "value") %>%
  rename(rank = all_of(first_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = value)

long_data <- data_block %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxa_cols), names_to = "taxon_col", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(abundance = as.numeric(abundance)) %>%
  left_join(tax_lookup, by = "taxon_col")



dom_plank_taxa <- long_data %>% 
  filter(!if_any(everything(),
                 ~ grepl("\\btotal\\b", .x, ignore.case = TRUE)))

dom_plank_taxa <- dom_plank_taxa %>% 
  select(-matches("total", ignore.case = TRUE))


taxa_pat <- paste(
  c("bivalv", "gastropod", "balanoid", "brachiopod", "copepod",
    "hydrozo", "malacostrac", "polychaet", "bryozo"),
  collapse = "|"
)


tax_cols <- intersect(c("Kingdom","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species"), names(long_data))

long_data <- long_data %>%
  filter(if_any(all_of(tax_cols),
                ~ grepl(taxa_pat, .x, ignore.case = TRUE)))

dom_plank_taxa <- long_data %>% 
  filter(!if_any(everything(),
                 ~ grepl("\\btotal\\b", .x, ignore.case = TRUE)))

dom_plank_taxa <- dom_plank_taxa %>% 
  select(-matches("total", ignore.case = TRUE))



```



```{r}
plot_df <- dom_plank_taxa %>% 
  select(Date,Seaweed,Kingdom, Family, Phylum, Order, Class, Genus, Species, abundance) %>% 
  filter(Seaweed != "Alaria")
```
